digest.linkedin_post_draft:
🚀 **Agentic AI hiring is exploding – and the talent gap is widening** 🚀

The latest LinkedIn Pulse analysis (July 8 2026) shows **86 000+ job ads** that tag *agentic‑AI* as a required skill – a **280 % year‑over‑year surge**. Median compensation for these roles now sits around **$153 k**, well above the overall AI market average.

What employers are looking for:
• **AI Agent Architect** – design the high‑level architecture of autonomous agents.
• **Autonomous Workflow Engineer** – build end‑to‑end pipelines that let agents orchestrate multi‑step business processes.
• **Agentic Systems Engineer** – blend systems‑engineering rigor with agent‑centric development.

Core skill tags that keep surfacing: **agentic‑AI**, **AI‑agent architecture**, **autonomous workflow engineering**, and **intelligent‑system design**.

👉 **If you’re a recruiter, make sure your postings use these exact titles and skill tags** – they’re now the primary filters job‑seekers rely on.
👉 **If you’re a professional, start highlighting any experience you have building LLM‑driven planning loops, safety guardrails, or API‑orchestration pipelines.**

The talent shortage is real, but the opportunity to shape the next generation of autonomous AI systems is even bigger. Let’s connect and share best practices!
